style: Grounded military sci-fi industrial: dark gunmetal machinery, desaturated olive armor panels, exposed fasteners, subtle hydraulics, restrained yellow accents. No text, no faces.

assets.name: CraneHookAssembly
assets.prompt: Heavy overhead crane hook assembly: a forged load hook hanging from a reinforced hook block housing with a sheave wheel and short wire rope lead
assets.intendedUse: Hangar ceiling rail prop above the maintenance plinth
assets.rig: Static prop; origin should sit at the top of the rope so it can hang from an overhead rail

assets.name: HydraulicMaintenanceLift
assets.prompt: Industrial hydraulic maintenance lift: a scissor-lift platform with a heavy base frame, crossed steel scissor arms, a grated work platform, and a large hydraulic cylinder
assets.intendedUse: Hangar floor prop beside a mech bay
assets.rig: Static prop; scissor arms and platform may later animate vertically (separate parts required)

assets.name: RoboticServiceArm
assets.prompt: Articulated robotic service arm on a bolted pedestal base, with a lower arm, upper arm, wrist joint and a heavy tool head, visible hydraulic lines and joint collars
assets.intendedUse: Hangar prop that services mechs; candidate for simple idle animation
assets.rig: Parts must be separate for joint rotation; pivots are NOT guaranteed at joints (review needed)

assets.name: DiagnosticConsole
assets.prompt: Armored diagnostic computer console: a rugged angled steel cabinet with a recessed screen bezel, a sloped keyboard tray, heavy corner guards and cable conduits
assets.intendedUse: Hangar terminal prop; screen part could later carry a SurfaceGui
assets.rig: Static prop; screen face should be a flat quad (review)

assets.name: CableReel
assets.prompt: Heavy industrial cable reel: a large steel drum wound with thick black power cable on a sturdy welded support frame with a crank handle
assets.rig: Static prop; drum may spin about its axle later

assets.name: ToolCabinet
assets.prompt: Mobile mechanical tool cabinet on four heavy casters, with a hinged double door, pull-out drawers, reinforced corners and a top work surface

assets.name: OverheadFloodlight
assets.prompt: Industrial overhead floodlight assembly: a rugged lamp housing with a protective cage and lens, on an adjustable mounting yoke and a ceiling bracket
assets.intendedUse: Hangar lighting fixture; a SpotLight can be attached to the lamp housing
assets.rig: Static prop; lens face should point -Z or be re-oriented (review)

assets.name: ShoulderArmorPrototype
assets.prompt: IF-42 military mech shoulder armor: a broad layered pauldron shell with overlapping armor lames hanging from its outer edge, a rugged mounting pylon and exposed fasteners
assets.intendedUse: Prototype to replace procedural PauldronShell*/PauldronCap* (see ASSET_PIPELINE.md)
assets.rig: Needs re-pivoting to the Torso-frame LocalCF and a left/right mirror before PartKit override; visual only for now
